messages:
Sam R: Heads upI moved from CA to OR midyear (June 15). My December paystub shows state taxes taken as CA for the entire year and my W-2 draft has all wages allocated to CA. I updated address in Workday in July. Is this expected?
Luis: similar happened to me when I changed states last year, payroll used the home state on file for the payroll system run. You might need a retro split.
Nora (Payroll): Thanks for flagging. We generally allocate wages by payroll period based on the state of record at run time. If you changed residency midyear and the change was processed after some runs, wages can be misallocated. We'll need to confirm which payruns used CA profile.
Sam R: What do you need from me to get this split corrected?
Nora (Payroll): Please attach: 1) copy of the Workday address change confirmation (date/time), 2) proof of OR residency (utility or lease) around July, and 3) the paystub PDF(s) for the affected months.
Sam R: uploaded workday-change.pdf and july-lease.pdf to the case. Case #PR-2026-518 created.
Elena (People Ops): FYI if there's a retro split we might need to file amended state returns or issue a W-2c. Nora, does TaxOps handle the filings or do we engage external vendor?
Nora (Payroll): For inter-state splits we handle state remittance corrections ourselves for simple cases. If the employee lived in a state with reciprocal agreements or if local jurisdiction requires employer filings, we may escalate to TaxOps or external vendor. We'll triage after reviewing documents.
TaxOps Bot: Case PR-2026-518 assigned to team:state-tax. Estimated review 5 business days.
Luis: will this create double tax exposure during the audit window?
Nora (Payroll): We aim to re-allocate wages and re-file withholding so you are not double-taxed. However, you may need to amend your personal returns if you already filed; we'll provide the corrected W-2 or W-2c and a note explaining the change for your tax preparer.
Sam R: Any ETA on W-2c if required?
Nora (Payroll): If we confirm misallocation, W-2c issuance typically within 14 business days after remittance corrections are posted. If the calendar year has closed, filing timelines depend on state processing times.
Elena (People Ops): We'll add a short guidance to the onboarding checklist: "Update payroll address BEFORE your first run in the new state; if mid-pay period, expect manual split". Nora can you draft?
Nora (Payroll): Will draft and share.
Sam R: Thanks. Leaving open until I see corrected W-2. :pray:
